brief:
Settlers surrounded a home belonging to the Abu Rida family in Qasra village south of Nablus, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident represents a continuation of tensions that have persisted in the West Bank locality.

The encirclement occurred as settler activity in Palestinian areas continues to draw international concern. Residents of Qasra have faced repeated incidents involving settlers in recent periods. The circumstances surrounding the siege, including its duration and any specific actions by those involved, remained unclear at the time of reporting.
title: Settlers encircle Abu Rida family home in southern Nablus village
